description:
Company Overview:

We are building Protege to solve the biggest unmet need in AI — getting access to the right training data. The process today is time intensive, incredibly expensive, and often ends in failure. The Protege platform facilitates the secure, efficient, and privacy-centric exchange of AI training data.

Solving AI’s data problem is a generational opportunity. We’re backed by world-class investors and already powering partnerships with some of the most ambitious teams in AI. The company that succeeds will be one of the largest in AI — and in tech.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, high-trust team of builders who are obsessed with velocity and impact. Our culture is built for people who thrive on ambiguity, own outcomes, and want to shape the future of data and AI.

The role

AI in healthcare advances safely if people can trust it. Right now, it’s being deployed faster than anyone can check how well it actually works. We’re solving that problem by building out our Assessments team, which runs independent evaluations on real patient records. Those records go beyond text and includes scans, pathology slides, and audio. We’re looking for the Founding Evaluation Engineer to join that team.

Working with our researchers, engineers, and customers, you’ll build the evals which include the tasks, the graders, and the auditors for the graders. In healthcare, the right answer isn’t always clear and can be hard to verify. Doctors disagree, a diagnosis can take months to confirm, and models are starting to match the experts we’d ask to grade them. If you care deeply about how to score a model when the answer is hard to verify, or when the model may be better than the people grading it, you’re the right fit.

What you'll do

  • Build the eval platform. You’ll build the platform so that our researchers’ tasks, graders, and auditors can plug in once and run against any model.

  • Build the graders. Our researchers design the graders but you own the implementation and the tooling to make eval design easier.

  • Stand up each new customer’s eval. Their models or AI applications are scored on tasks that fit their product.

  • Score what is hard to verify. Partner with our researchers to build scoring for cases where doctors disagree or the answer only shows up later.

  • Audit the grader. Work with our researchers to find cases where the graders were wrong and build guardrails against that.

What success looks like

  • 30 days: Learned how our assessments run end to end, met our researchers and first customers, shipped first improvements to our graders and a first customer evaluation run.

  • 60 days: Owning the harness and graders end to end for every active customer, ensuring that every grader is tested before it scores.

  • 90 days: A new benchmark goes from researcher design to first scored run in 2 days, and every score ships with a measured grader error rate.

What you'll bring

  • You’ve built evals end to end: dataset, harness, grader and report.

  • You’ve evaluated models on tasks with no single right answer.

  • You’ve caught a misleading result, such as leaked answers, a bad answer key, or a metric that hid a failure.

  • You’ve built an eval harness that other people ran.

  • Nice to have: you’ve built an automated grader and measured how often it was wrong.

  • Nice to have: you’ve worked with doctors or other experts to write rubrics or labels.

  • Nice to have: you’ve built evals with multi-modal data.
